description: This file is a shell script used for testing git repository operations involving shallow clones and bitmap indexing. The script sets up a test environment with a git repository, performs commits, creates a shallow clone, and tests fetch behavior with bitmap support in shuffled or shallow repositories.

methods.name: test_shallow_bitmaps
methods.description: A test function that sets up a shallow git repository, configures bitmap writing, and performs fetch operations to verify behavior with shallow clones and bitmaps.
